source_dataset: How2Sign English Translation manually realigned train split
deduplication: generate once per exact NFKC-whitespace-normalized casefolded English sentence, then map back to every official record
batch_size_selection_note: Batch size is frozen at 4 to match the validated v4-1000 protocol. A smoke comparison showed that larger bf16 batches can change a small number of greedy-decoding outputs.
important_warning: Outputs are deterministic text-derived pseudo labels, not gold ASL annotations. Automatic quality checks do not replace qualified ASL review.
